title: Live DOM on physical devices
blurb: HTML buttons as the keys of a Stream Deck, an element printed by a receipt printer and a CSS ticker on an LED matrix. Each canvas is converted to the bytes its device accepts, and a simulated device is drawn from those bytes.
question: Can ordinary HTML be the interface of a device that is not a browser window: a key pad with a display in each key, a receipt printer, an LED matrix?
result: Yes as far as the bytes: three canvases are converted to HID reports, ESC/POS and RGB565, and simulated devices are drawn from them. No real device has been tried.
